name: LaunchRepo
summary: Toolkit that gives your AI agent playbooks for 299 launch platforms, plus a product brief and a local submission tracker.
description: A downloadable toolkit (private GitHub repository) you run with your own AI coding agent: Markdown playbooks for 299 launch platforms and directories, a reusable product brief, selection guidance and prompts, and a local dashboard that records each submission's status and next actions. You keep control of logins, CAPTCHA and 2FA; one payment covers unlimited products you own.
contains: 299 active platform guides as of October 7, 2026 (84 verified free, 156 conditional free, 53 unavailable)
one-time price: €49 incl. 19% VAT (reference), rises 20% after every 20 sales
private repo: platform playbooks, product brief, selection guidance, setup guides and prompts
local dashboard/tracker app showing products, statuses and next actions
agent works in your own Chrome via Chrome DevTools MCP; you handle logins, CAPTCHA and 2FA
supports nine coding agents incl. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI
